messages:
Rhea (PM): Quick sync: we need a neat decision for GA observability UX and the gating signals. Customers want clear cost controls + reliable error visibility.

Kai (ENG): Backend can do per-tenant sample rates + emergency throttle. Propose defaults: sample_rate=0.002 (0.2%), error_preserve=15%, adaptive uplifts on sustained error spikes. We'll expose an API + Console card.

Marta (SRE): For safety, set a hard daily cost cap default $100/tenant. When hit: 1) cut sample_rate x10, 2) switch to header-only traces, 3) add tenant flag "throttled" visible in Console. Also add global kill-switch.

Lee (ML): Launch acceptance: run a 48h canary over 3 tenants. Acceptance if at default rates we capture >=92% of priority error groups and anomaly detection F1 drop <=4%. If failing, we enable targeted retention for that tenant.

Rhea (PM): Console requirements (minimal): tenant card shows "budget USD today", "projected 24h spend", and badge: normal/uplifted/throttled. One-click actions: "Increase retention" (enterprise only) and "Pause hi-fi traces" for support.

Kai (ENG): API sketch (string form):
```
sampling_policy: default_rate=0.002; error_preserve_pct=0.15; adaptive=[{on:error_rate>1% -> rate=0.02, ttl=3600}]
budget: daily_usd=100
```

Marta (SRE): Ops runbook: if >2 tenants throttle in 24h, trigger auto-revert to conservative global sample_rate=0.0005 and notify oncall. Add dashboard for throttled tenants.

Rhea (PM): Draft launch checklist:
- Sampling policy API + Console card (owner: Kai)
- Budget enforcement + throttle UX + runbook (owner: Marta)
- Canary plan + acceptance evals (owner: Lee)
- Customer docs + FAQ on expected visibility at defaults (owner: Rhea)

OpsBot: Created issue infra/telemetry#2045 1: "per-tenant sampling + budget caps" assigned to @Kai.

Kai (ENG): I'll push a console mock by Wednesday and a minimal API in sprint 2.

Lee (ML): I'll shortlist canary tenants (one enterprise, one mid-market, one internal) and run the recall tests as soon as API is available.

Marta (SRE): I'll draft runbook entries and the throttle dashboard.

Rhea (PM): Great. Reconvene Friday 9:30 to validate canary criteria and finalize launch gate text. :white_check_mark:
